name: Stabinator
description: Stabinator was a modified Mark VII gladiator droid who worked for the Grakkus Arena around 0 ABY and had 15 clean kills on the Wumpo circuit using a power lance. Stabinator was manumitted after a slave uprising instigated by Wrollanppf. The droid later recounted the happenings in an interview included in Maz Kanata's Smuggler's Guide.
